notes: §1985:VI.5.15.5 GR2 requires "Format 2 can be used only in connection with condition-names" and "Wherever the THRU phrase is used, literal-2 must be less than literal-3". The first sentence conforms at 85: on a non-88 entry DataBinder.BindEntry refuses the THRU phrase (ConditionOnlyPhraseOf, COBOL2167), a list of literals (COBOL1585) and the VALUES ARE spelling (CheckValueConnective, COBOL2177), all probed. The second is implemented by DataBinder.CheckRangesAscending (called from BindCondition, no edition arm, COBOL2961) for literal operands only: numeric pairs, signed and non-integer pairs, ZERO on a numeric subject, nonnumeric literals in the program collating sequence, an equal pair and every pair of a list are refused (probed). Not implemented: a pair in which either end is a figurative constant other than a numeric ZERO, an ALL literal or a symbolic-character; the member skips it (its StringValue reader returns no value), although §1985:IV.4.2.2.2.3 says "A figurative constant may be used whenever 'literal' appears in a format" and the compiler fixes the program collating sequence at compile time. HIGH-VALUE THRU LOW-VALUE, SPACE THRU SPACE, "Z" THRU SPACE, QUOTE THRU SPACE, ZERO THRU SPACE on a PIC X item and ALL "Z" THRU ALL "A" all compile clean at --std 85 (and at --std 2023, the same member). The witness is the refusal of 9 THRU 1 on a PIC 99 item.

next.reason: 1985: 'Format 2 can be used only in connection with condition-names ... Wherever the THRU phrase is used, literal-2 must be less than literal-3.' The first sentence is kept: §2023:13.18.63.3 SR33 'Formats 3 and 5 may be specified only when the level-number of the subject of the entry is 88.' The ordering requirement is narrowed: §2023:13.18.63.3 SR26 keeps 'literal-2 shall be less than the value of literal-3' unconditionally only for classes other than alphanumeric or national; for alphanumeric or national literals it applies only 'when the runtime collating sequence is known', and 'The runtime collating sequence is unknown when the collating sequence is defined by a locale or ... otherwise determined at runtime'. A THRU range 1985 refused can therefore be accepted. Looser, not an exception condition.
